subject: Hosted API commit increase & rate-threshold repack for ShopPulse
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena@shoppulse.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@shoppulse.com
Date: 2028-04-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal talk — needed increase for April/May window

Hi Kimberly / Vanessa,

Thanks for the renewal packet you sent earlier — we've reviewed consumption and it looks like our hosted API usage is trending ~2.3x higher than last quarter. Attached is our baseline-usage-Q1-2028.csv to show the spike tied to the new personalization experiments.

Short version: we need to increase our committed monthly volume from 1M tokens to 2.5M tokens starting May 1 to avoid frequent soft-throttles. We also need a clearer mapping of rate thresholds (burst vs steady) — the current burst window is too narrow for our peak windows, which leads to dropped requests and more fallbacks.

Constraints: procurement will only sign an amendment (SOW) if final terms include a 12-month amendment and a PO that matches the invoice. Budget is approved but timing is tight; can you get me an amendment + invoice that reflect the new monthly commit and the adjusted rate bands?

If convenient, can we do a short call on Monday to lock the effective date? I'm copying contracts for the procurement thread.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Martinez
Head of Integrations, ShopPulse

Attachments: baseline-usage-Q1-2028.csv, SOW-draft-2028-04-14.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Martinez <elena@shoppulse.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-14T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal talk — needed increase for April/May window

On 2028-04-14 10:12, Elena Martinez wrote:
> Short version: we need to increase our committed monthly volume from 1M tokens to 2.5M tokens starting May 1 to avoid frequent soft-throttles.

Hi Elena — really appreciate the fast visibility and the file. Good news: we can support a 2.5M monthly committed uplift and restructure the rate thresholds so your peak windows have a wider burst envelope.

Proposal (high level):
- Effective date: 2028-05-01 (can be earlier if you need it).
- Commit: 2.5M tokens/month (12-month amendment).
- Ratebands: introduce a "peak bucket" (temporary burst pool) that expands your burst window from 15s -> 60s for calls routed to the high-throughput model. This will reduce failed calls during batch personalization jobs.
- Pricing: incremental blended unit price for the uplift months; include a 6% volume credit for the 12-month commit.

I've attached a first-pass amendment (proposed-amendment-v1.pdf) and an invoice template. Karthik — can you confirm the blended unit math and whether we can frontload a 30% credit for month 1 to ease ShopPulse's onboarding spike?

Elena — if that looks reasonable I'll convert the amendment to a DocuSign and hand off the invoice for PO generation. Happy to do a 20-minute sync Monday at 10:00am PT.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0189

Attachments: proposed-amendment-v1.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-04-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal talk — needed increase for April/May window

Kimberly / Marissa,

Re: the blended unit math — rough calc below based on current list rates and negotiated discounts:
- Current commit: 1,000,000 tokens @ $0.004/token effective unit = $4,000/mo.
- Proposed commit: 2,500,000 tokens; incremental 1,500,000 tokens priced at $0.0036/token after 6% volume credit = $5,400 incremental.
- New blended: ~$9,200/month pre-tax.

I can approve a 30% credit applied to month 1 as a one-time onboarding concession (exec-signed promo budget). That means month 1 invoice will show a credit of $2,760 and net due ~$6,440.

Operational note: increasing the burst window to 60s for the high-throughput model increases our temporary capacity exposure. Recommend we include a "grace burst" clause in the amendment that caps simultaneous sustained burst consumption at 4x baseline for a maximum 72 hours. If ShopPulse needs longer, we can transition them to a temporary Dedicated pool for predictable latency.

Happy to join the Monday call if helpful.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deals, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Martinez <elena@shoppulse.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: contracts@shoppulse.com
Date: 2028-04-18T08:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal talk — needed increase for April/May window

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of procurement asks before signing: 
1) We need the amendment to explicitly note the effective date (we prefer 2028-04-25 to align with our billing cycle).
2) SOC 2 type II evidence (or the audit date and auditor contact) for our security review.
3) A final invoice reflecting the 12-month commit and the month-1 onboarding credit for our PO.

Also — to avoid the Dedicated pool conversation, could you confirm the expected 95th percentile latency under the new rateband (60s burst window) for our typical calls? We run short-LLM generation (avg tokens = 48) but with high QPS during personalization runs.

If you can get the amendment and the invoice over by Friday I can route to legal and procurement and aim to have the signed DocuSign back the following week.

Elena

On Fri, Apr 14, 2028 at 13:04, kimberly_park@redwood.com wrote:
> Proposal (high level):
> - Effective date: 2028-05-01 (can be earlier if you need it).
> - Commit: 2.5M tokens/month (12-month amendment).
> - Ratebands: introduce a "peak bucket" (temporary burst pool) that expands your burst window from 15s -> 60s for calls routed to the high-throughput model.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Elena Martinez <elena@shoppulse.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, contracts@shoppulse.com
Date: 2028-04-20T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Final amendment & invoice (SP-2028-042)

Elena / Contracts,

Attached: invoice-SP-042-20280420.pdf and an updated amendment that sets the effective date to 2028-04-25 and includes the burst "grace" clause Karthik recommended. The DocuSign envelope is live at the link below; I flagged the invoice with the 30% month-1 credit so the PO will match the net due.

Performance note: under the adjusted rateband (60s peak bucket) our internal tests for workloads matching your profile (avg tokens 48, QPS up to 55 during peaks) show median latency ~42ms and 95th percentile ~240ms when routed to the high-throughput instance. Those numbers assume KV cache hits for repeated prompt prefixes; cold KV cases can add ~80–120ms. If latency is absolutely critical we can provision a short Dedicated burst window as discussed.

Next steps I recommend:
- Contracts: sign DocuSign (link below) with effective date 2028-04-25.
- ShopPulse: submit PO to match invoice SP-042.
- Ops: after signature we will flip the routing rule for your account at 00:00 PT on 2028-04-25 and monitor for 72 hours.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/ABC123456789
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-SP-2028-042

Thanks — let me know if you want us to accelerate the flip to 2028-04-23.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice-SP-042-20280420.pdf
